chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, was the most complete of people in salat (prayer) and the most concise of them. When he entered into salat (prayer), he would say: “Allahu Akbar” and “Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.”

key_terms.أَتَمَّ: Most complete or most perfect in performance.
key_terms.اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ: The opening takbir, meaning Allah is the Greatest.
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful; recited at the beginning of salat (prayer).
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم begin his salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the salat (prayer) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as both most complete and concise. It indicates his practice at the opening of salat (prayer), beginning with takbir and then reciting “Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.”
